after.zh: 极点是另一台相机的光心在这张图里的位置：所有极线都从它发出。它垂直于 F 的每一列，所以是两列的叉积，也就是 Fᵀe′ = 0 的解。
after.en: The epipole is where the other camera's centre appears in this image: every epipolar line comes out of it. It is perpendicular to every column of F, so it is the cross product of two columns: the solution of Fᵀe′ = 0.

t.zh: 左图里不同的点，在右图里有不同的极线。把它们都画出来，会发现一件事：它们都交于同一点。
t.en: Different points in the left image have different epipolar lines in the right image. Draw them all and you notice something: they all pass through one point.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：只用 F 算出这一点，写成 (x, y, 1)。
t.en: Your task in this level: work this point out from F alone, written as (x, y, 1).

brief.zh: 右图里所有的极线都交于同一点，叫极点。只用 F 算出它，写成 (x, y, 1)。
brief.en: In the right image every epipolar line passes through one point, the epipole. Work it out from F alone, written as (x, y, 1).

hint.zh: 每条极线都是 F 的列的组合。两条极线交在哪里，你会算。
hint.en: Every epipolar line is a mix of the columns of F. You know how to find where two lines meet.
